name: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd
title: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd - 526668 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Hotel operator (asset-light, leased) reports Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to Rs 91 cr and EBITDA up 36% to Rs 25 cr; no supply discipline data, capex limited, pipeline ~400 keys in 12-15 months.

capex.quote: most of our properties are on lease where our component of CAPEX is very minimum

triggers.label: RevPAR growth ~18% Orchid, 17% Lotus
triggers.quote: RevPAR for our two brands that is Orchid and Lotus grew 18% and 17% respectively in Q1 FY27

triggers.label: Orchid ARR flat, growth via occupancy
triggers.quote: we decided to keep rates flat and sell more and more rooms

triggers.label: ~400 keys added in 12-15 months
triggers.quote: we are looking at around 400 keys addition, maybe next one year or 15 months from now

triggers.label: No numeric FY27 guidance given
triggers.quote: we don't want to give any guidance as such

guidance.quote: our target is to take EBITDA margins up to 30%

red_flags.label: Management claims 'EBITDA flow-through 75%' vs 'EBITDA 27%' inconsistency; 'margin 530 points' misstated as 5.3%
red_flags.quote: EBITDA margins have expanded by a robust 530 points that is around 5.3% to 27%

red_flags.label: Dehradun delayed; owner-dependent timelines
red_flags.quote: Dehradun is delayed. There are challenges due to which they are delayed. That could be delayed by another six months.

evasions.quote: we don't want to give any guidance as such
we'll give guidance on that maybe next quarter or so

summary.headline: Kamat Hotels Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 10% to INR 91 crore and EBITDA 36% to INR 25 crore, margin 27% vs 22%.
